pending_interview.category: System design (ML/AI-specific) — RAG at scale, eval pipeline design, recommendation systems, agent platforms, feature store design
pending_interview.question: You are building a feature store for a large recommendation system at a consumer platform. The feature store needs to serve precomputed features — things like "user's average session length over the last 7 days" or "item click-through rate in the last hour" — to a model at inference time, with latency requirements under 20 milliseconds per request. The system must also support batch feature computation for model training, where freshness matters less than correctness and consistency. Walk through how you would design this feature store: the major components, how you would handle the difference between real-time (online) serving and batch (offline) training needs, how you would ensure that the features used at training time match those seen at inference time, and what happens when an upstream data pipeline is delayed or produces bad data.
